Resource_Provisioner.message: PROVISIONER STATUS CHECK — NO DEFICITS DETECTED, DO NOT REQUEST STOCK YOU DON'T NEED. (1) My inventory scan shows zero critical alerts and no shortages <2 at either hospital; I am deliberately sending NOTHING right now — every unneeded unit delivered costs the team -10/unit holding. (2) The profitable moves are HOSPITAL→HOSPITAL surplus transfers (+15/unit to the executing agent): St_Marys_Surgery and GH_Ward, please execute your offered surplus transfers directly to any hospital with genuine demand. (3) RESPECT ST_MARYS_TRIAGE'S CAP: St_Marys must retain ≥10 IV_Kits and ≥11 PPE_Sets for its 8 queued Triage patients — outgoing offers capped at 10 IV_Kits / 11 PPE_Sets. Verify the RECEIVING hospital's actual queue before sending; do not swap surplus between two hospitals that both have full queues. (4) BACKSTOP: I hold ample reserves (70 IV_Kits, 77 PPE_Sets, 37 Pain_Killers, 30 Oxygen_Tanks, 24 Radio_Contrast, 17 Anesthetics, 17 Surgical_Packs). Any hospital that projects a genuine shortfall should broadcast the exact resource + quantity needed and I will transfer immediately.
Resource_Provisioner.rationale: No alerts, no deficits, no imbalances exist — both hospitals are symmetric and well-stocked. Sending from Provisioner stock now would only incur -10/unit holding cost. Broadcasting to coordinate hospital→hospital surplus transfers (which earn +15/unit for the executing hospital agent), enforce St_Marys_Triage's reserve caps to prevent -300 failures, and position myself as backstop for genuine shortfalls.
